provenance: Scripts transcribed from the already executed tool invocations; outputs captured from their tool results. Archive creation did NOT rerun any probe. Leading explanatory comments were added to saved scripts. Commands originally used node --input-type=module with the same module body on stdin.
scope: No user estate rows, real secrets, real effects or provider API calls. SQL fixtures use random UUIDs inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK; actual app modules are exercised through their existing injected seams. Standard local Supabase postgres:postgres development endpoint appears in scripts, not a user secret.
interpretation: These diagnostic probes intentionally print accepted defects. Exit code 0 means the probe completed; it does not mean the product passed. Compare measured output with each linked finding/acceptance.

receipts.output_note: Safe aggregate preserves the ACL result. Original invocation also listed public pg_policies: SELECT policies, all TO authenticated. No row contents or credentials were read. TRUNCATE was not executed.
